root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by a double free in the Btrfs subsystem where `create_space_info_sub_group()` erroneously frees the `sub_group` structure in the error path after `btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type()` has already triggered the kobject release callback to deallocate the same memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly traces the execution flow where `kobject_put()` leads to `kfree(sub_group)` within `space_info_release()`, followed by a second `kfree(sub_group)` in `create_space_info_sub_group()`, while the patch diff confirms the fix by removing the redundant `kfree(sub_group)` statement from the error handling condition in `create_space_info_sub_group()`.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement appears in the error handling path of create_space_info_sub_group() after btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() has been called on line 289. When btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() registers the kobject, it can trigger the kobject release callback which deallocates sub_group. If the subsequent error path then executes kfree(sub_group), this causes a double free since the memory was already freed by the kobject release callback.
